[Description]

This library is not based on any existing framework (DQMH, AF, etc.) and can be used as part of any UIs being developed.\0D\0A\0D\0APanels are run as asynchronous VIs so this approach is not suitable when a LOT of elements are needed. For a faster performing, more light-weight library when lots of elements are needed in an array-like UI check out the ControlArray package.\0D\0A\0D\0APanel management includes moving VI panels around different subpanels, popping subpanel contents out as standalone windows, and toggling the visiblity of a panel.
